flow: ui-path — navigate the site's own hash route (#label/<Label> / #search/<q> / #inbox) and read the rendered conversation rows

steps.input: args.view (default #inbox; label route 'label/<Label>' or search route 'search/<q>' — url-encoded)
steps.note: Gmail's SPA routes its own views through the # hash — the site's JS boots the requested view. Must run in a logged-in session; otherwise the site 302s to accounts.google.com (measured 2026-09-23).
Conversation-row surface (DOM-UNVERIFIED — re-tune on first capture). An empty view honestly returns 0 rows.
Same per-row fields as gmail_read_inbox (subject .y6, sender .bog, snippet .y2, date .xW, unread .zE / dot). DOM-UNVERIFIED.

output.rows: array<{id, subject, sender, snippet, dateTag, unread}>

rpc: none — RPC bridge deliberately not driven; reads off the rendered page
stealth: plain hash-route navigation + DOM read in the user's own logged-in session
